posts.title: Sordid little stories: of class and living poor
posts.description: When I was 17 years old, my family’s car was repossessed. It happened at night, the Dodge sedan my parents had bought used towed away late one evening while we were watching TV. Cars get repossessed when their owner—who doesn’t really own the car yet, just pays for it—misses enough car payments in a row. […]
